name: hubspot
description: Connect any agent to a live HubSpot CRM through the official HubSpot MCP server. Read and write contacts, companies, deals, tickets, leads, engagements, products, quotes, invoices, orders, subscriptions, and segments — plus read-only access to campaigns, landing pages, blog posts, users, and pipelines.

interface.shortDescription: Read and write your HubSpot CRM through the official HubSpot MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent becomes your CRM operations hub — looking up contacts, updating deals, managing tickets, checking pipeline progress, and creating follow-up tasks. No more digging through HubSpot for every update. Just ask your agent to find a contact, move a deal to the next stage, show your current pipeline, or log an interaction. Everything happens through conversation, directly with your live CRM data.
defaultPrompt: Who are my top open deals and what stage are they in?
Find the contact information for [company name].
Show me a summary of my sales pipeline this quarter.
